name: FFS_PROPERTY_DESC
description: Record in this table describes one property.

columns.name: PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Custom property unique identifier.

columns.name: ENTITY
columns.description: Custom property entity Type (Appt,Inventory,resource,user,service request).

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Label of custom activity/inventory/user/resource property.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Type of custom activity/inventory/user/resource property.

columns.name: TEMPLATE
columns.description: Regular expression for custom property value verification.

columns.name: GUI
columns.description: GUI representation of custom activity/inventory/user/resource property.

columns.name: LINE_COUNT
columns.description: Custom property count of lines visible on the screen.

columns.name: DUPLICATE
columns.description: Custom property flag that defines whether Copy property value upon prework/reopen or not.

columns.name: MIME_TYPES
columns.description: Custom property type of file (for file properties).

columns.name: OPTIONS
columns.description: Custom property bitmask set of options that define behaviour of this property.

columns.name: MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_X
columns.description: Custom property maximum size of captured picture (X). (for image properties).

columns.name: MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_Y
columns.description: Custom property maximum size of captured picture (Y). (for image properties).

columns.name: XSL_REGEX
columns.description: Custom property expression which is used to transform property value to Xml.

columns.name: XSL_TRANSFORMATOR
columns.description: Custom property xslt expression which is used to transform Xml To Html.

columns.name: FILE_SIZE_LIMIT
columns.description: Custom property file max size limit for file properties in Mb.

columns.name: APPLICATION_LABEL
columns.description: Field for application label....

columns.name: FUSION_BUSINESS_OBJECT
columns.description: Field for fusion attachments business object.

columns.name: FUSION_CATEGORY_LABEL
columns.description: Field for fusion attachments category label.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).
